Broad leadership but MAJOR divergence argues for selectivity and tactical sizing.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

DOW (1W: +8.72% | 1M: +36.11%) ABOVE TREND, OXY (1W: +6.12% | 1M: +20.47%) ABOVE TREND and PFE (1W: +4.15% | 1M: +3.01%) ABOVE TREND showing relative strength. Key risk: MAJOR divergence across large caps (AAPL, NVDA, MSFT) and mixed bullish headlines (NVDA +85 vs price BELOW TREND) — watch for confirmed trend breaks before increasing exposure.
